title: unified-rollouts: proactive auto-rollback for canary/AB/shadow traffic
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: recent incidents showed slow detection and manual rollback of model regressions during canary and shadow experiments. This PR implements proactive automated rollback for unified rollouts (canary/A-B/shadow) based on configurable metric-driven policies. Design summary: extend rollout policy schema with a new 'auto_rollback' block (thresholds, metric, window_sec, grace_period_sec, min_traffic_percent, cooldown_sec, evaluation_fn), implement a state machine extension in rollout-controller to evaluate streaming metrics windows, compare to baseline or control variant, and trigger rollback when sustained violations exceed configured counts. Integrations: hooks into existing observability metrics (per-route latency/error-rate/quality-sli), ties to Redwood Console alerts, and emits structured events for audit and incident workflows. Safety: rollbacks are gated by min_traffic_percent and cooldowns, include a shadow-only mode where only alerts are emitted without automatic traffic change, and require a two-step opt-in for enterprise tenants (default off for Dedicated/Private). Migration: schema bump v1.0 -> v1.1 with a migration loader that backfills sensible defaults; rollout policies without auto_rollback are unaffected. Testing: unit tests for state machine logic, integration tests with eval-harness to simulate regressions, perf canary to validate controller overhead, and a staged rollout plan to dogfood on canary route. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-2345) [x] schema changes and migration [x] unit + integration tests [x] CI green after flaky retry [x] documentation updates and console UX copy [x] rollout plan for gradual enablement. Impact: improves mean-time-to-recover for model regressions and reduces manual intervention for experiments.

review_thread: Leo Chen: Can we avoid a noisy rollback during short-lived spikes? Suggested adding a grace_period and cooldown fields. — Addressed and added tests for noise suppression.
Priya Kapoor: For Dedicated/Private tenants we should default auto_rollback to off. Also asked for audit log events on trigger. — Implemented tenant opt-in and structured audit events.
Marcus Li: Request: expose metric window size as seconds and provide heuristics in docs for common SLOs. — Added docs and console helper text.
Leo Chen: CI flaky on integration test, reran and passed, approving after verifying migration loader is idempotent.
Priya Kapoor: Approved. Left minor UI copy nit that was fixed in follow-up commit.
release_notes: Adds auto-rollback support to unified rollouts: canary/AB/shadow policies can define metric windows and automated rollback thresholds, includes migration to schema v1.1, safe defaults and tenant opt-in for Dedicated/Private, and observability hooks for audit and alerting.
notes_for_ops: Staged rollout plan: enable for internal dogfood routes for 48h, then gradual enable on low-traffic canaries. Monitor rollout-auto-rollback dashboard and alert if rollback rate > 0.5% of rollouts in 24h. Migration script available at scripts/migrations/migrate-rollouts-v1-to-v1_1.py
testing_summary: Unit tests for state machine + parser (coverage ~85%), integration scenarios simulate latency and quality regressions with eval-harness, perf-canary validated controller overhead, manual QA on Console config UX performed by product QA.
